input_values.schema_version: the authority bundle schema_version being published
input_values.raw_entries_digest: the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS serialization of raw/manifest.json entries only, excluding its generation_id

generation_id_contract.derivation: generation_id is the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS serialization of an object containing exactly input_fields with the defined input_values; no pointer, provenance, or raw-manifest self-reference participates in the digest.
generation_id_contract.directory_binding: The immutable generation directory basename must equal the rederived generation_id.

pointer_schema.generation_id_rule: generation_id must satisfy generation_id_contract and equal the basename of the resolved immutable generation directory.

provenance_schema.generation_id_rule: generation_id must satisfy generation_id_contract and rederive from the published decision, raw manifest entries, policy_digest, and trial_inventory.

path_rules.canonical_locator: must equal the canonical_locator in this contract
path_rules.decision_path: must equal fair-scheduler-decision.json and be repository-relative
path_rules.provenance_path: must equal provenance.json and identify this provenance document
path_rules.raw_root: must equal raw/ and be repository-relative
path_rules.raw_manifest_path: must equal raw/manifest.json and be repository-relative

sha256_rules.decision_sha256: must equal the SHA-256 of decision_path and current.json decision_sha256
sha256_rules.raw_manifest_sha256: must equal the SHA-256 of raw_manifest_path and current.json raw_manifest_sha256
sha256_rules.provenance_self_identity: current.json provenance_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of provenance.json; provenance.json does not embed its own digest

provenance_schema.policy_and_trials_rule: policy_digest and trial_inventory are required provenance fields and must describe the published decision generation.

raw_manifest_schema.generation_id_rule: generation_id must satisfy generation_id_contract and rederive from this manifest's entries without using the manifest generation_id as a digest input.

source_dist_resolver_rule: Source and dist admission must use the same locator parser and validator semantics and enforce the pointer, generation_id_contract, provenance_schema, and raw_manifest_schema rules identically; an invalid or non-rederivable generation_id must fail closed.
publication_rules: Before creating the generation directory, derive generation_id exactly with generation_id_contract; an invalid or non-rederivable generation_id must abort publication fail closed.
Create a new generation directory named by the derived generation_id for every publication and never mutate a published generation.
Validate the pointer, decision, provenance, raw manifest, repository-relative containment, and every required SHA-256 before publication.
Atomically replace current.json only after the complete new generation validates.
fail_closed_rules: A missing, escaped, tampered, incomplete, or SHA-256-mismatched pointer or generation makes authority unavailable.
An invalid, non-lowercase, malformed, or non-rederivable generation_id, or a generation directory whose basename does not equal it, makes authority unavailable.
No historical, rejected, planner-run-specific, or alternate root may be used as a default or fallback.
